findings.description: Text is too close to the edge of its container. Add at least 8px (ideally 12–16px) of padding inside bordered, outlined, or colored containers.

issues.title: 44px 点击高度未覆盖所有剩余链接
issues.impact: 窄屏品牌链接的可点击高度偏小；桌面配置指南的独立目标只有21px高，未达到本轮指定的44px检查门槛。下载、演示、导航、FAQ及普通页脚链接已达到44px。
issues.standardsNote: 44px为本轮检查要求，也对应WCAG 2.5.5的增强目标尺寸；本项不能表述为WCAG AA失败，axe WCAG AA未报违规。
issues.recommendation: 给 .brand 加 min-height:44px；把 .workflow-note a 的 display:inline-flex、align-items:center、min-height:44px 从手机规则提升到基础规则。

detectorInterpretation.classification: in-context false positives / intentional boundary composition

detectorInterpretation.classification: print rules applied by static detector to screen findings
